objects.title: Alfama
objects.summary: A hillside neighbourhood of narrow streets, viewpoints and layered everyday life.
objects.why: Alfama works as a doorway into Lisbon through streets, music, food and memory rather than as a single attraction.

objects.title: Fado and the city
objects.summary: A way into Lisbon through voice, place, memory and the rooms where music is performed.
objects.why: The point is not only to find a venue, but to understand the cultural thread that connects neighbourhood, music and experience.

objects.title: Paint an azulejo
objects.summary: A hands-on tile-painting experience that turns a visual detail of the city into something you do.
objects.why: It moves the user from seeing a material culture to participating in it.

objects.title: Mar Mikhael
objects.summary: A Beirut neighbourhood entered through streets, workshops, cafés, nightlife and changing urban layers.
objects.why: It is useful as a neighbourhood object because many discoveries can connect back to the same piece of city.

objects.title: The Lebanese table
objects.summary: Food as a network of dishes, ingredients, rituals, regions and the people who make them.
objects.why: Instead of reducing food to restaurant search, the Story layer connects what you eat to culture and place.

objects.title: A Beirut food walk
objects.summary: A flexible thread through bakeries, cafés, street food and neighbourhood stops.
objects.why: The experience can connect several Places while the Story layer explains what each stop means.

reels.caption: A street can be the discovery. Then the city opens sideways from it.
Start with Beirut as it is encountered: one street, then the relationships around it.
